serverStoredForSales.motion_entitlements: server-verified subscription per account (store, product_id, original_transaction_id, state, expires_at, verified_at); refreshed by App Store Server Notifications v2 / Play RTDN
serverStoredForSales.motion_trial_ledger: one Motion+ trial start per Motion account (app_id, started_at) across the five apps
serverStoredForSales.paymentCardData: never reaches the app or Motion servers

ageAndConsent.declaredBirthMonthYearAndCountry: stored with the account (Apple OtherDataTypes / Play Other info, Motion publishing profile)
ageAndConsent.parentEmail: sent once for approval; only a one-way digest is kept
ageAndConsent.storeAgeRange: Declared Age Range (iOS 26+) / Play Age Signals checked on the device; not stored on the server
